correctness.rationale: Geiser complementation D -> -K-D pairs the four known families of exceptional curves into singleton-indexed and two-subset-indexed bitangents, including hyperflexes in odd characteristic. Nefness against exceptional divisors and their complementary cubics forces each multiplicity into {0,1,2}; square zero and anticanonical degree two then give just the listed five patterns. Their pencil existence can also be seen by quadratic Cremona change of marking: choose three maximal multiplicities and use a'=2a-b_i-b_j-b_k for degree reduction to H-E_i (at degree 3 choose 2,1,1). A Frobenius-invariant class descends over the finite field since its Brauer group vanishes, and the descended complete pencil has split projective-line base. Independent cycle-coloring of the multiplicities and cycle-union enumeration of bitangent indices reproduces all 15 distinct pairs, with 10 and 11 distinct individual entries in the two columns. Powers of a recovered point permutation determine both finite-etale zeta functions. As a direct check of the surface zeta formula, over F_(q^n) the blowup adds q^n times the number of original points fixed by F^n to 1+q^n+q^(2n), which gives the displayed factors.
residual_risks: Depends on the ground-field blowdown and odd characteristic. No small-field realization of all 15 types, or recovery of the isomorphism class, is asserted.
